purpose: Blinded human comparison of tiny neural versus handcrafted DEM ranking
selection: Eight Moon places x three physical scales; fixed geographic Earth sample; top two from each method plus two random controls, with overlap filled by next handcrafted ranks
limitations: This is a stratified Earth subset, not global Recall@K. No human labels are present yet. Material and mission evidence is incomplete.
